[[File:UnidentifiedTwilekMalePreigos.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] juggler in [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]]]]
{{Quote|So Stars' End wanted a juggler or whatever and they get a storyteller. So what? We'll tell them to go sue the Entertainers' Guild!|Han Solo|<ref name="HSSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
'''Juggling''' was a dexterity based skill<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> that was both an entertainment profession<ref name="HSSE" /> and recreational activity practiced by many including [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]]. There were three basic patterns to juggling (from easiest to difficult): the cascade, the reverse cascade, and the shower. Motti would practice these patterns in a [[Heavy Gravity Room]] set at 3Gs.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] jugglers performed in [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]] for the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="Bound">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>

[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] had a tendency to juggle objects inadvertently as well.
